svg.title: Android App Review: Static + dynamic analysis of an Android app's attack surface.
svg.desc: Android App Review. Static + dynamic analysis of an Android app's attack surface. Offense: insecure storage, cleartext traffic, hardcoded secrets, weak certs. Defense: combined static and dynamic testing, platform permission review. Tools: MobSF, Frida, ADB, Burp Suite.

g.text: Static + dynamic analysis of an Android app's attack surface.
OFFENSE › insecure storage, cleartext traffic, hardcoded secrets, weak certs
DEFENSE › combined static and dynamic testing, platform permission review
